findings.title: Partial refund pays out order.total_cents instead of the approved amount_cents
findings.evidence: The function signature still takes 'amount_cents' and the docstring comment states 'amount_cents is the partial amount the support agent approved', but the return statement is now 'return gateway.refund(order.txn_id, order.total_cents)'. Any caller invoking refund(order, 500) on a 10000-cent order sends 10000 cents to the gateway.
findings.recommendation: Revert to passing the approved partial amount, e.g. 'return gateway.refund(order.txn_id, amount_cents)'. If a full refund is a separate use case, add a distinct code path rather than overloading this parameter, and keep the parameter honoured so the public contract of refund(order, amount_cents) is not silently broken.
